blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Dante Alinsunurin returns as Alas Pilipinas men’s volleyball coach, while Italian Angiolino Frigoni will be handling the women’s squad in preparation for the FIVB World Championship in 2029. Philippine National Volleyball Federation (PNVF) Executive Director Atty. Miguel Carlos Pacifico Suarez announced the major changes to the national indoor volleyball teams on Thursday. The beach volleyball squads, meanwhile, will remain intact following their campaign in the 20th Asian Games in Nagoya.
